record.paper: A note on intersecting hypergraphs with large cover number

dossier_meta.paper: A note on intersecting hypergraphs with large cover number
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Problem (projective plane structure in near-extremal constructions)
dossier_meta.statement_text: It would be interesting either to find a different type of construction of near-extremal intersecting $r$-partite hypergraphs $H$ with $\tau(H)$ close to $r$, or to show that near-extremal constructions must contain large pieces from a projective plane.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors observe that except for a few sporadic small examples, all known constructions of intersecting $r$-partite hypergraphs $H$ with $\tau(H)$ close to $r$ are based in some way on finite projective planes.
